title: Concept: a nuget.config whose `<packageSources>` lists no `<add>`
description: nuget.config declares a source list that inherits every machine-level feed, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through nuget.config (nuget).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a source list that inherits every machine-level feed.
